title.narrative: Revenue Mobilization Thematic Fund (RMTF)

description.narrative: The RMTF will strengthen developing countries' capacities, with a particular focus on ACP countries, on tax policy and tax administration. This will lead to an increased use of analytical tools and research on tax matters, a strengthened tax policy formulation and tax administrations' managerial and operation capacity and therefore to an enhanced revenue institutions performance.
